findings.concern: readActivity returns 413 for an oversized newest event, preventing older history pagination
findings.resolution: Oversized snapshots produce an explicit immutable event metadata summary with snapshotOmitted and a full shared-entry download link; the original sequence advances the cursor and original before/after evidence remains unchanged. The authenticated full-entry route streams bounded SQL text chunks, checks session and trip membership during the download and rejects entries larger than 64 MiB.
